messages.content: Help me update the launcher information in the JNI Bridge with the launcher path '/usr/local/bin/dbeaver' and the launcher name 'DBeaverLauncher'?

function.name: JNIBridge_setLauncherInfo
function.description: Sets the launcher information in the JNI Bridge, which includes the path and name of the launcher. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

launcher.description: The full path to the launcher. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

name.description: The name of the launcher. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.
